methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote:
This paper aims to fill this gap, providing a state of art of ISO 50001 certifications in Italy and reporting 
the results of a survey about the certified organizations in the national territory

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Questionnaire survey of ISO 50001 EnMS implementation status in Italy (background motivations, which ISO 50001 requirements companies/consultants find hardest, most-disregarded elements, and energy savings achieved). EnPIs and the energy baseline are discussed only as ISO 50001 requirements and via a generic, reference-attributed definition of EnPI types; the paper presents, proposes, evaluates or critiques no specific EnPI/EnB measurement model that could be identified and characterised (no model variables, functional form, or construction/estimation approach given). Incidental mention -> ineligible under v2.3.

paper_type.evidence_quote:

stage1.notes: Survey of ISO 50001 EnMS adoption in Italy (motivations, requirement difficulty, savings). EnPIs/baseline appear only as ISO requirements; no specific EnPI/EnB model characterised (ineligible).
